_doc: Behavioural qualification of three native SM sub-tiles that CLOSED with no bench of their own (loop: 'AUTO-MERGE skipped: no behavioral positive bench'). They carry no golden of their own; the owner-accepted evidence is the composition gate smn_native_sm (tools/ref_tile/composition_gates.json). The gate cannot run at their source commits (tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py has no --rmax there), so it is bound by module identity: every module in the tile's elaborated closure, read from the kit's own source list at the routed commit, compared with rtl/ at the commit the gate ran on. Written by Claude el1013-smh-r11, 2026-10-13.
